svg.title: Acquire source NMR and DOSY measurements
svg.desc: Acquire source NMR and DOSY measurements. Bruker AvanceIII, BBI probe; quantitative1H uses 64k data points. DOSY dstegp3s double stimulated echo; quadratic gradient ramp. Source labels D20 as pulse-length gradient and P30 as diffusion time; these labels are retained without external repair. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and molecular or particle structure are unassigned. Source-derived conceptual operation flow; not a measured apparatus reconstruction.
svg.text: Acquire source NMR and DOSY measurements
proton frequency: 500.13 MHz; sample temperature: 298.15 K; spectral width: 16 ppm; relaxation
delay: 30 s; gradient steps: 64 steps; gradient strength: 2–95 % (Percentage of probe maximum
Bruker AvanceIII, BBI probe; quantitative1H uses 64k data points. DOSY dstegp3s double stimulated echo;
quadratic gradient ramp. Source labels D20 as pulse-length gradient and P30 as diffusion time; these
labels are retained without external repair.
Acquisition atmosphere: not reported. General air handling is a separate source convention.
Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and molecular or particle structure are unassigned.
Source-derived conceptual operation flow; not a measured apparatus reconstruction.
